purpose: Judge source-scene preservation, scene-specific handwriting, restrained doodles, readable spacing, and a mood-matched glass music player against seven gathered examples.

examples.title: Poolside notes with the reference inset
whyItWorks: The original poolside photo remains realistic and recognizable
Short notes point to the hat, drink, water, light, and overall mood
The glass music player fits the sunny palette without hiding the subject

examples.title: Accessories become the story
whyItWorks: The matcha, sunglasses, and bag each receive one specific note
Small hearts and sparkles support the composition without clutter

examples.title: A relaxed garden portrait
whyItWorks: Notes describe the jacket, shades, greenery, and relaxed energy
The compact player stays secondary to the seated portrait

examples.title: Mirror-selfie details stay readable
whyItWorks: Arrows connect short notes to the phone, bag, outfit, and room light
White line work remains legible over a bright interior

examples.title: Golden-hour beach mood
whyItWorks: The handwritten observations follow the hat, drink, jewelry, and sunlight
The player colors echo the warm beach atmosphere

examples.title: City walk as a journal page
whyItWorks: Architecture, clothing, and the walk itself receive tailored notes
Sparse line work preserves the street portrait's negative space

examples.title: A colorful market moment
whyItWorks: Food, clothing, textures, and the setting become personal memory cues
The interface and annotations match the scene's playful color
